name: Hydroguard Retainer: Shifting Currents North -> West transition draws a card
notes: Direction-CHANGE triggers ($shiftingCurrentsTransitions in GameLogic.php, keyed "FROM->TO", fired centrally from ChangeShiftingCurrents()) are distinct from a static-facing check -- reaching one in a controlled fixture setting requires an actual call to ChangeShiftingCurrents(). Kongming, Fel Eidolon's own Inherited ability (GameLogic.php ~5703-5708) queues an ICONCHOICE 'adjacent direction' decision on every Spell activation while it's in the champion's lineage, so patching Fel Eidolon's CardID into Subcards (same lineage-patch technique as tera-sight-preserve-draw, reused here purely as a trigger mechanism) plus activating any Spell (Tera Sight, 0 reserve) reaches the choice under full fixture control. ICONCHOICE's response is just the chosen direction string verbatim (goldfish default picks options[0], GameLogic.php:261-264) -- answered 'WEST' (adjacent to the seeded NORTH facing) to fire Hydroguard Retainer's NORTH->WEST transition. Hand count: starts at 9 with this deck/patch, unchanged after Tera Sight resolves (played 1, its own 'Draw a card' replaces it), then +1 more once the WEST decision actually changes the direction and the transition's Draw($player,1) fires -- isolating the transition's own draw from Tera Sight's.

rulesClauses: Whenever your Shifting Currents changes from North to West, draw a card.
